doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07

title: Billie's band at Luchenbach's and the Kingfish
summary: Billie led the band with George Lewis, McGee and Boyd and had been at the Kingfish before.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Yeah. Mm-hmm. That's the beginning of that. Oh, I see. So you were the first band in there then? No, no. Mealy. Mealy was the first band in there. And they didn't stay there too long, I don't think, before they got me in there, before I was down there. Oh. Well, who was the band leader when you went to Lutches? Who was the band leader? I was the band leader. Mm-hmm. And who'd you have with you then? I had D.D. George Lewis, Clay Badge. stuff with stuff That's when I got a job. I was working at the Kingfish.
You were working at the Kingfish before you went to lunch.
Oh, yeah. That's why I got married to Kingfish.
Oh, yeah. Well, who'd you have in the band now?
George Lewis McGee on drums. He's in California.
Now, that's not Herb Moran's brother. That's another McGee. Another McGee. Yeah, Herb's brother's dead.
I had McGee, George, myself, and I had, who had on trumpet at the end?
When Boyk. Boyk, Boyk, Boyk, Boyk, over the river. Boyk, he played trumpet. He put the trumpet down and played bass afterwards.
I didn't ever know about him.
Bert Stevens. All right. Well, Boyk was there. It was Boyk, myself, and George Lewis, and McGee.
